data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 contradicts SRC_001: SRC_002 asserts a program: eval will reject a generic-exception mutation silently because the typed contract is violated, whereas SRC_001 demands the suite verify the mutation's name explicitly describes ignoring endpoint drift. These are incompatible because a mutation named 'generic_exception' passes SRC_002's typed-code assertion while failing SRC_001's name-description check. This contradiction is refuted if the eval framework couples mutation naming conventions to typed exception contracts, making a name violation mechanically imply a type violation.
